data.name: Kallu
data.long_meaning: The name Kallu is derived from the Hindi language. It is a diminutive form of the name Kal or Kala, which means 'black' or 'dark'. In Hindu mythology, the god Shiva is often referred to as Kala, signifying time and the destroyer of all illusions. Kallu can be seen as a playful and endearing name for a little boy, representing the protective and nurturing qualities of the divine being Shiva.
data.spiritual_meaning: Represents the protective and nurturing qualities of Lord Shiva.

historical_references.reference: Kallu, a goddess revered by the Reddis of Kadapa district, Andhra Pradesh, India, is believed to have protected the villages from the invading armies of Allahuddin Bahman II.
